misconceptions.description: Sharing a group doc as 'Anyone with the link can edit' when only the team should have edit access
misconceptions.trigger: learner sets a shared assignment to public edit and a stranger alters it
misconceptions.feedback: Share to specific people with the least access they need. Use 'Anyone with link: view' or named editors, not public edit.

misconceptions.description: Editing a teammate's text directly with no comments or suggestion mode, erasing their work silently
misconceptions.trigger: learner rewrites a section and the teammate cannot tell what changed or why
misconceptions.feedback: Use Suggesting mode or comments so teammates can see and accept changes, instead of overwriting their work invisibly.

misconceptions.description: Everyone editing the same paragraphs at once with no agreed owners, causing collisions and lost edits
misconceptions.trigger: two members retype the intro at the same time and one version is lost
misconceptions.feedback: Assign section owners up front (you take intro, I take methods) so edits do not collide on the same text.

misconceptions.description: Not agreeing on internal deadlines, so a teammate's part lands minutes before the real due time
misconceptions.trigger: the last section arrives at 11:55 PM for an 11:59 PM submission with no time to review
misconceptions.feedback: Set an internal deadline earlier than the real one (for example 24 hours before) so the team can review and fix.
